description: PART 1 -- Repoint ff-idcams's private CatalogService/VsamService traits at the reconciled ff-dscatalog traits and route DEFINE/REPRO/DELETE dataset operations through DatasetAccess. ff-idcams stays a THIN orchestrator (Req 21). Trait-SOURCE repoint + call-site reconciliation, NOT a behaviour change: IDCAMS syntax/output/LASTCC/MAXCC/condition codes are unchanged (Req 28.7). Delivers idcams-emulator Req 28.1-28.7 / Task 29.1-29.8. MUST land first (Part 3 and the whole task depend on it; Req 28.6 sequences the repoint before any crate deletion).
steps: Read context.json and plan.md Part 1 FIRST. Read the reconciled traits: crates/ff-dscatalog/src/service.rs (CatalogService + DynCatalogService), vsam_service.rs (VsamService + VsamType/VsamParams/VsamHandle/BrowseHandle/BrowseDirection/AccessMode/KeyField/Record/VsamError), dataset_access/trait_def.rs (DatasetAccess), and crates/ff-dscatalog/src/lib.rs for the exact public re-exports. Read the precedent crates/ff-dsalloc/src/catalog_bridge.rs + allocation.rs.

Step 1 (dep + DAG proof): edit crates/ff-idcams/Cargo.toml -> add 'ff-dscatalog = { path = "../ff-dscatalog" }' under [dependencies]. Run cargo check -p ff-idcams -- a clean resolve proves no dependency cycle (Cargo rejects cycles). Confirm by reading crates/ff-dscatalog/Cargo.toml, ff-volume/Cargo.toml, ff-vfs/Cargo.toml that NONE depend on ff-idcams/ff-dsalloc (target DAG: ff-idcams -> ff-dsalloc -> ff-dscatalog -> ff-volume -> ff-vfs; direct ff-idcams -> ff-dscatalog allowed).

Step 2 (TDD red): add crates/ff-idcams/src/services_tests.rs (keep services.rs under 400 non-test lines) and/or extend the executor test module with tests asserting the RECONCILED surface: IdcamsServices holds dyn DynCatalogService + dyn VsamService; DEFINE CLUSTER drives ff_dscatalog::CatalogService::create_dataset + VsamService init with catalog rollback on init failure; REPRO record copy flows through the reconciled VsamService/DatasetAccess get/put (no local record loop); DELETE flows through delete_dataset + VsamService teardown / DatasetAccess::dispose atomically; CC/output unchanged. Each test: // Validates: Requirement 28.x. Run cargo test -p ff-idcams and CONFIRM RED.

Step 3 (repoint trait source): in crates/ff-idcams/src/services.rs DELETE the private 'pub trait CatalogService' and 'pub trait VsamService' declarations; import the reconciled traits/types from ff_dscatalog; change IdcamsServices to hold Arc<dyn DynCatalogService> + Arc<dyn VsamService> + a dyn DatasetAccess handle for record I/O (keep AllocatorService local or map onto DatasetAccess::resolve, documented). Rewrite mocks::MockCatalogService/MockVsamService to implement the reconciled traits (model on service.rs's test MockCatalogService + catalog_bridge.rs's MockDatasetAllocator). KEEP IDCAMS-specific param types ff-dscatalog does not model (DefinePathParams/define_path, verify_integrity, Export/Import, DefineAixParams, BuildIndexResult) as orchestration-local helpers, NOT a re-added private trait. Update crates/ff-idcams/src/lib.rs re-exports and crates/ff-idcams/src/error.rs (local CatalogError/VsamError superseded at the trait boundary). FIX ASCII: replace box-drawing separators with // === ... === and em dashes with -- in every .rs file touched.

Step 4 (reconcile executor call sites): in crates/ff-idcams/src/executor/handlers.rs map each call onto the reconciled trait (DEFINE CLUSTER -> create_dataset(&str, DatasetAttributes) + initialize_dataset/create_ksds.. ; DEFINE GDG -> create_gdg_base(&str,u8,bool); DEFINE AIX -> define_aix(base,aix,KeyField); DEFINE PATH / VERIFY / EXPORT / IMPORT stay orchestration-local with a comment that ff-dscatalog models no trait method; DELETE -> destroy_dataset + delete_dataset + dispose; ALTER -> update_dataset/rename_dataset; LISTCAT -> list_datasets(&DatasetFilter)+get_dataset_attributes; PRINT/REPRO -> open(&str,AccessMode)->VsamHandle + start_browse(..)->BrowseHandle + next_record + put, record copy via the reconciled seam / DatasetAccess; BLDINDEX -> build_index(aix)). Map error variants to ff_dscatalog::CatalogError/VsamError in match arms; KEEP identical IDC message codes and CC so Req 28.7 holds. If handlers.rs exceeds 400 non-test lines, split by command group (handlers_define.rs/handlers_delete.rs/handlers_io.rs) as a pure refactor.
Step 5 (TDD green + grep): run cargo test -p ff-idcams until GREEN; grep that no private trait CatalogService/VsamService and no removed-crate reference remain in ff-idcams.
Step 6: flip TCR Req 28.1-28.7 rows to PASS with the new test names; mark idcams-emulator tasks.md Task 29.1-29.8 [x]. Record findings in FEAT-001.json.
acceptance_criteria: crates/ff-idcams/Cargo.toml depends on ff-dscatalog; cargo check -p ff-idcams resolves with no dependency cycle (Req 28.1, ownership 22.6).
No private 'trait CatalogService' / 'trait VsamService' remains in crates/ff-idcams; ff-idcams uses the reconciled ff-dscatalog traits + DynCatalogService wrapper (Req 28.1, 28.2).
DEFINE/REPRO/DELETE route through the reconciled traits + DatasetAccess per Req 28.3/28.4/28.5; verified by services_tests.rs assertions.
IDCAMS syntax, output formatting, and LASTCC/MAXCC/condition-code semantics are byte-for-byte unchanged (Req 28.7), proven by the CC-invariance integration tests.
No live ff-vsam-services / removed-crate reference inside ff-idcams (Req 28.6).
All ff-idcams .rs files touched are ASCII-only and under 400 non-test lines.
cargo test -p ff-governance-tests stays GREEN (acyclic DAG intact).
verification: grep_search for 'trait CatalogService' and 'trait VsamService' in crates/ff-idcams/**/*.rs returns no private declarations
findings: FEAT-001 complete; scoped checks clean (cargo fmt clean; cargo check/clippy/test -p ff-idcams clean = 34 unit + 22 integration pass; cargo test -p ff-governance-tests = 16 pass incl. idcams_has_no_storage_engine_dependencies and the DAG rules; cargo check -p ff-dsalloc clean). A clean `cargo check -p ff-idcams` after adding the ff-dscatalog dep is the acyclicity proof (no cycle). FOR PART 3 (crate deletion): grep across crates/ff-idcams finds ZERO `trait CatalogService`/`trait VsamService` private decls and ZERO `ff-dataset-catalog`/`ff-vsam-services` references -- Part 3's pre-check for ff-idcams is already satisfied; nothing in ff-idcams blocks deleting ff-dataset-catalog. HANDLERS SPLIT: the single executor/handlers.rs was replaced by a directory module executor/handlers/{mod.rs,define.rs,mutate.rs,query.rs,io.rs} (pure refactor to stay under the 400-line rule) -- define.rs=DEFINE CLUSTER/AIX/PATH/GDG; mutate.rs=DELETE/ALTER; query.rs=LISTCAT/VERIFY/EXPORT/IMPORT/BLDINDEX/SET; io.rs=PRINT/REPRO. IDCAMS-LOCAL ORCHESTRATION HELPERS KEPT (ff-dscatalog models no trait method; defined in services.rs as plain data, NOT a re-added private trait): DefinePathParams, VerifyResult, ExportParams/ExportResult, ImportParams/ImportResult. Their executor paths: DEFINE PATH -> registered as a catalog entry via CatalogService::create_dataset (orchestration-only); VERIFY -> CatalogService::dataset_exists check; EXPORT -> dataset_exists check + IDC0004I; IMPORT -> CatalogService::create_dataset + IDC0005I; DELETE PATH/GDG -> CatalogService::delete_dataset of the base (reconciled trait has no delete_path/delete_gdg_base). DEFINE GDG EMPTY/FIFO flags are parsed+validated but not forwarded (reconciled create_gdg_base carries only dsn/limit/scratch) -- documented in define.rs. TRAIT WIRING: IdcamsServices now holds Arc<dyn DynCatalogService> + Arc<dyn VsamService> + Arc<dyn DatasetAccess> + Arc<dyn AllocatorService>. AllocatorService (DD->DSN) stays local to ff-idcams (orchestration step, not catalog authority). REPRO/PRINT route record I/O through the reconciled VsamService open/start_browse/next_record/put/close seam (Req 28.4 permits this). DELETE additionally threads DatasetAccess::resolve->dispose(Delete) best-effort (NotFound ignored) so Req 28.5's DatasetAccess::dispose path is real; the authoritative catalog removal is CatalogService::delete_dataset. The default DatasetAccess is a real ff_dscatalog::CatalogDatasetAccess::in_memory (services::default_dataset_access), mirroring the ff-dsalloc catalog_bridge precedent -- ff-idcams keeps NO direct storage engine. ERROR MAPPING: local CatalogError/VsamError removed from error.rs (AllocatorError kept); handlers match reconciled variants (CatalogError::DuplicateDataset/DatasetNotFound; VsamError::DatasetNotFound/UnsupportedOperation/DuplicateKey/Internal) while keeping identical IDC codes + CC (Req 28.7). INTEGRATION-TEST RETARGETING: crates/ff-idcams/tests/integration_tests.rs now imports ff_dscatalog::{CatalogError,VsamError}; three tests retargeted to reconciled variants (execute_define_cluster_duplicate_name -> CatalogError::DuplicateDataset; execute_define_cluster_rollback_on_vsam_failure -> VsamError::Internal; execute_delete_entry_not_found -> VsamError::DatasetNotFound). ASCII: box-drawing/em-dash fixed in services.rs, lib.rs, Cargo.toml description, and the integration test file; pre-existing non-ASCII in untouched files (messages.rs, parser/*, ast.rs) left as-is (out of FEAT-001 scope). lib.rs now re-exports ff_dscatalog::{CatalogService,DynCatalogService,VsamService} (not local traits) + services::{AllocatorService,IdcamsServices}. NEW TEST FILE: src/services_tests.rs (8 reconciliation tests, each // Validates: Requirement 28.x). FILE SIZES: all touched .rs under 400 non-test lines (services/mocks.rs is the largest at 394). COMMITTED NOTHING (owner runs the full `cargo gate --build`).
